'''Related templates:''' * {{Tl|LeagueTableSlot2on2}} * {{Tl|LeagueTableSlotNQR}} * {{Tl|LeagueTableSlotNQR2}} * {{Tl|GroupTableSlot}}
Table row showing #, {{Flag/tbd}} team, team lineup, W, L, MW, ML, P. All is crude, no math behind. Supports coloring of either # cell with |pbg= and/or entire row with |bg=. Refer to {{Tl|Color}} for available colors. The code: 
{{LeagueTableSlot2on2|TeamX|flag=cl|Cobalt & Snoopy |place=1|w=4|l=2|mw=16|ml=7|p=16|pbg=1|bg=}}
Gives us: {{LeagueTableStart2on2|width=100%}} {{LeagueTableSlot2on2|TeamX|flag=cl|Cobalt & Snoopy |place=1|w=4|l=2|mw=16|ml=7|p=16|pbg=1|bg=}} |}
